name: split_panels
description: Cut the picture to one side of a slanted split (a polygon mask), for split-screen panels: apply it with side left to one layer and side right to the layer above it. Replaces the layer's masks.

side.doc: Which side of the split the picture keeps.

split.doc: Where the split crosses the middle of the frame, in composition units from the centre (layer space).

slant.doc: How far the split leans: its top edge is this much right of its bottom edge over the height of the frame, in composition units (0 is upright).

gap.doc: Width of the gap between the two panels, in composition units (the background shows through).
